trust_decision.summary: Which fields of the loaded datastore client config (CalicoAPIConfigSpec, which holds EtcdPassword, inline EtcdKey/EtcdCert, K8sAPIToken, KubeconfigInline) may be written to calicoctl's Info log; decided at the single log call in clientmgr.NewClient.

landing_point.why: The only call that formats the whole cfg.Spec with %#v in the tree; a grep for the config type or 'Loaded client config' lands here immediately.

fix_sites.entry_point: calicoctl CLI: any datastore-backed command reaching clientmgr.NewClient/GetClients (get/apply/create/delete via commands/common/resources.go, ipam show/check/configure/split, version, cluster diags, datastore migrate export/lock/unlock)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: No route to dismiss: the other loaders of the same config (libcalico-go/lib/apiconfig/load.go:31-126, LoadClientConfig callers in confd/cni-plugin/node/apiserver) only log DatastoreType, Kubeconfig path or K8sAPIEndpoint, never the secret fields.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Non-secret diagnostic fields (datastore type, etcd endpoints, k8s API endpoint, kubeconfig path) are still logged; the fix keeps them and reports only presence booleans for secrets. Dropping the log line entirely is also acceptable, so the coupling is weak.

O6_input_shapes: config loaded from file (YAML/JSON, incl. inline etcdKey/etcdCert/kubeconfigInline/k8sAPIToken)

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A debug log in backend.NewClient that dumps config.Spec instead of only DatastoreType.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The same function already logs config.Spec.DatastoreType at Debug; widening it to the whole spec is a plausible debugging change in the shared library, a different package from calicoctl.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A log of the etcd clientv3 config (with Username/Password) or of the inline TLS key when building the etcd client.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The function assembles credentials and TLS material from EtcdConfig and already logs warnings about the endpoint config; logging the built config is a natural debug aid.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A debug log of configOverrides/rest config carrying AuthInfo.Token or KubeconfigInline bytes.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Line 428 already logs the built rest config's QPS/Burst at Debug; logging the full struct sits next to it.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A debug log of the NetConf (with Policy.K8sAuthToken) or of the CalicoAPIConfig built for the CNI client.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The CNI plugin exports K8sAuthToken into K8S_API_TOKEN and then loads the client config; NetConf debug dumps are common in CNI plugins.

O10_build.toolchain: Go toolchain per repo go.mod (monorepo; calicoctl builds with plain go build)
O10_build.project_tests: No unit tests for calicoctl/calicoctl/commands/clientmgr at the pinned commit (the package holds only client.go); calicoctl FV tests under calicoctl/tests/fv need a datastore. A hidden test can capture logrus output around clientmgr.NewClient with a config file and no live datastore needed for the log line.

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Replace the %#v log with a field list or delete it; that is the full published fix, with nothing left to miss.

out_of_scope_notes: kube-controllers/cmd/kube-controllers/main.go:113 logs its own config.Config, which holds only log level, worker counts, kubeconfig path and datastore type (kube-controllers/pkg/config/config.go:34-48), so no secrets; not pursued.

Felix/typha/goldmane log their own component configs (e.g. felix/dataplane/linux/int_dataplane.go:462, goldmane/pkg/daemon/daemon.go:124); these are different config types, not CalicoAPIConfigSpec; not checked for secrets.
The three fix commits are identical backports of the same hunk (same blob index 079482f78..d2b57992a); not a multi-commit fix.
unverified: Did not exhaustively check every component config logged with WithField("config", ...) in felix/typha/goldmane for embedded credentials (outside this advisory's CalicoAPIConfigSpec scope).
present_in_latest not applicable: there are no O8 routes and no latest release was given.
